name: Treacy & Wiersema’s Value Disciplines
diagnostic: Are we positioned primarily around Operational Excellence (cost, reliability, efficiency), Product Leadership (continuous innovation, status), or Customer Intimacy (tailored flexibility, relationship depth)?
artifact: A Value Trilemma Optimization Map establishing a primary operational focus alongside non-negotiable performance thresholds for the other two disciplines.
trap: Promising market-leading craftsmanship, lowest category pricing, and bespoke personalization simultaneously, which confuses operational priorities.
pedigreeFull: Michael Treacy & Fred Wiersema (*The Discipline of Market Leaders*, 1993; Harvard Business Review). A corporate strategy framework asserting that market leaders optimize for exactly one operating dimension while maintaining baseline thresholds in the remaining two.
